hypothesis: A bounded algebraic certificate can make exact source-aware minimization independent of the original evidence volume; branching only on sources used by an actual linear proof may avoid enumerating every source-deletion combination.
contract: The same finite-field augmented-row-span and joint-provenance contract as source_lift/PLAN.json. At most two source withdrawals, provenance width at most two. Preserve changed conclusions, including loss of determinacy or contradiction removal. No model calls or inferred natural-language equations.
candidate: Build the source/exterior lifted basis, discard access to the original collection, then reverse-delete rows. To decide whether a row is removable, find a linear proof from the remaining certificate. Any defeating withdrawal must hit a source in that proof while avoiding the tested row's own sources. Recurse on those possible source hits to depth k, memoizing withdrawal sets. Keep a row only with an explicit failing-withdrawal witness. One reverse-delete pass is inclusion-minimal because removing more rows cannot make a previously necessary row redundant.
controls: Per-provenance basis (cheap but potentially too large)
Union of bases over all admissible withdrawal sets, with per-provenance compression and early stopping at the original rank
That optimized union followed by the same exact proof-directed pruning
Direct proof-directed pruning of the per-provenance basis, without an algebraic lift
generation: Eight random augmented equations per numbered source; consistent with one hidden random assignment never supplied to a compiler. Single-source provenance is that source. Joint provenance is that source and a uniformly selected other source. The two case families therefore vary dependency structure, not the answer policy. Retain all generated rows, zero coefficients and any accidental degeneracy.
verification: Every returned row must be an unchanged member of the input. Exhaustively enumerate every withdrawal set up to budget. Compare exact row spaces: full-rank retained subsets are certified by their inclusion and the full input's independently computed rank; any rank loss invokes independent reduction of all surviving original rows. Every retained refined row must have a valid essentiality witness in the final certificate. Include independent actual-solution enumeration, rare direction loss, contradiction removal, mixed joint provenance and over-budget refusal in regression tests.
screen: All 12 family/source-count/seed cells must pass correctness. Candidate packet bytes must be at most half the per-provenance control and no more than 1.1 times the smallest positive control. At matched certificate size (at most 1.1 times the smallest positive control), require at least 2x lower median construction time than the fastest eligible positive control over three rotated repetitions. Do not switch metrics or tune source order after results. A timeout or missing comparator rejects the screen.
resources: Single local standard-library process, maximum 30 seconds per compiler invocation, at most 4096 input rows, deterministic seed/cohort. Timings are a development screen on a shared host, not milestone 3/6 evidence. A separate untimed invocation measures peak traced allocation and is also bounded. No paid services, held-out serving inputs, calibration edits or remote soak changes.
priorArt: Representative-family kernelization, proof/hitting-set branching, and semantic minimization are established tools. The research candidate is their concrete combination for source-backed mutable memory. Passing this screen would justify isolated broader tests, not establish a new theorem, priority, an agent QA improvement, secure erasure or total archive-memory saving. Preserve the failed unrefined v1 gate.
